pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with varying edge angularity. Patches on the mid-flank are large and contiguous with slightly softened borders, while patches on the lower flank and hind leg are smaller, more fragmented, and exhibit smoother pixel gradients.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored corridors forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-section but expands into wider, less defined areas toward the ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the visible portion of the neck mane, presenting as a jagged line against the blurred background.
